errors.evidence: The generated description includes the full name for the abbreviation OSI, "Индекс на електронното правителство" (e-Government Index), which is not present in the visual information of the chart itself. The prompt explicitly instructs to focus only on what is visually represented.

The description states that the units are dimensionless ("безразмерни"). The Y-axis has no units specified. Stating they are dimensionless is an interpretation, not a direct observation. The objective description should be that no units are indicated.

The description states that the increase in 2020 is compared to the 'previous year'. However, the x-axis ticks are every two years (2018, 2020), so the comparison is to the value from two years prior, not the previous year.

errors.text_span: Фигурата представлява линейна диаграма... без прекъсвания, с ясно изразен спад между 2012 и 2014 г. и последващо монотонно нарастване от 2014 до 2020 г.
errors.evidence: The prompt asks for the description to be a single paragraph ("един цялостен параграф"). The generated text is split into two paragraphs, which violates the formatting instructions.
